verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe an API framework for interactive bots that react to messages, plus a Botserver for running them in production. That implies bots receive incoming messages, but the pack never describes the real-time events API or connection mechanism itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a real-time events API/queue or gateway connection, coverage of event types beyond messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time delivery.
